1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah (Jalan Damansara) Nama.
(Sekatan Penggunaan Jalan) Kuala Lumpur, 1975.

2. Kereta-kereta motor yang berat muatannya melebihi lima tan ada- Larangan.
lah dilarang daripada berjalan di sebahagian Jalan Damansara iaitu di

antara simpangnya dengan Jalan Datuk Abu Bakar sehingga ke
simpangnya dengan Jalan Johar.

3. Kereta-kereta kepunyaan Kerajaan Persekutuan atau Kerajaan Pengecualian.
Negeri atau mana-mana pihakberkuasa tempatan atau mana-mana
pihakberkuasa berkanun yang menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diletakhak

padanya oleh undang-undang Persekutuan atau undang-undang Negeri

adalah dikecualikan daripada peruntukan-peruntukan Perintah ini.

Diperbuat pada 3 haribulan April, 1975.
(DBKL. 275/67; P.N. (PU?) 177.1

TAN SRI Yaacob ABDUL LATIFF,
Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

ROAD TRAFFIC ORDINANCE, 1958

WHERBAS by Gazette Notification No. P.U. (B) 36 of 6th February,
1975, notice was given of the intention to make an order under section
49/58.       61 (2) of the Road Traffic Ordinance, 1958:

AND WHERBAS no objections were received against the making of
such an order:

NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 61

49/58.        of the Road Traffic Ordinance, 1958, the Commissioner of the City of
Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the Commissioner of Road

Transport, and after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in section 61 (2) of the Ordinance, hereby makes the following order:

Citation.      1. This order may be cited as the Kuala Lumpur (Jalan Damansara)
(Restriction on Use of Roads) Order, 1975,

Prohibition. 2. Motor vehicles the laden weight of which exceeds five toms are
prohibited from using that part of Jalan Damansara between its
junction with Jalan Datuk Abu Bakar until its junction with Jalan
Johar.

Exemption. 3. Vehicles which are the property of the Federal or State Government
or of any local authority or any statutory authority exercising powers
vested in it by Federal or State law shall be exempted from the
provisions of this order.

Made this 3rd day of April, 1975.
(DBKL. 275/67; P.N. (PU?) 177.
TAN SRI YA‘ACOB ABDUL LATIFF,
Commissioner of the City of
Kuala Lumpur
